caption:
The video depicts a close-up of a circular metal assembly resting on a brushed-metal tabletop. The device has an inner ring of small U-shaped metal clips and an outer ring of larger cylindrical roller pieces arranged around a flat central disc. Two hands are present: one steadies the device, the other holds a small cylindrical metal piece at the upper-right rim. Viewed from a low side angle, the left hand's two fingertips press the central disc while the right hand keeps the cylinder pinned, the arrangement showing little visible change across the whole assembly.

The viewpoint then shifts to a higher, rotated angle, with the left hand gripping the device's upper-left edge instead of pressing the center. The left hand keeps the assembly steady while the right hand continues to pin the small cylindrical piece at the top-right rim, making only minor positional adjustments. Near the end, the outer rollers and inner clips on the right side reorient, tilting outward and opening the ring as the cylinder shifts slightly.

The gap opens.
